ops.title: linux-host CI: wait for a freshly published dependency to resolve before package-install
ops.description: The 'Install the host' step runs capt-hookd package-install, which resolves capt-hook's dependencies through the package index with uv tool install. A PR that moves a pin to a release published minutes earlier fails this one job until the index lists the new version (run 38089608616 on PR #352, cc-transcript 14.40.0). The earlier lockfile sync in the same job is not affected because uv.lock pins wheel URLs. capt-hookd already waits for its own release in awaitProductRelease; nothing waits for a dependency. Investigation 6693ed9 holds the log excerpt and timings.

ops.text: A pin bump opened within minutes of the dependency's publish passes linux-host without a manual re-run, or the step fails with a message naming index propagation
